correctness.rationale: After each dimer deposition, m unoccupied vertices remain per side and k labels are shared. There are m^2-k available rate-one edges partitioned into counts k(k-1), 2k(m-k), (m-k)^2, proving the transform recurrence with terminal (m,k)=(1,0)/(1,1). Verified mean exactly for n=2..8 from a separately implemented rational dynamic program. Symbolically verified nonnegative F_m drift and exact waiting-time partial fraction identity in Sympy. The factorial-moment upper bound controls cumulative drift O(log n/n^2), giving E T_n=H_n^(2)-1/n+O(log n/n^2); the finite n=2 case has opposite sign and is correctly not claimed uniformly.
